decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR [ev-62482924a855] spells out what the one-line note [ev-e4e1acb49af8] leaves out. It adds an `alias` term to `amiSelectorTerms` on the karpenter.sh/v1 EC2NodeClass, which selects EKS optimized AMIs and can pin a version, e.g. `al2023@latest` or `al2023@v20240625`. [ev-0ae22fbded5e] lists the supported aliases (al2023, al2, bottlerocket, windows2019, windows2022). It also says the PR drops the Ubuntu AMI family and `EC2NodeClass.Spec.AMIFamily`. That is enough to write the subject (v1 EC2NodeClass amiSelectorTerms alias), the change (added) and the applicability (v1 EC2NodeClass users). One caveat: the PR bundles those removals, and the same release's 'reimplement amiFamily' [ev-3f84c56f02fe] and 'convert unpinned Ubuntu EC2NodeClasses' [ev-c4d7d1a131dd] entries suggest they did not ship as-is, so the consequence should be written for the alias addition only.
